implementation_summary: Three targeted additions: (1) 'notestr-forgotten-slots' appended to KNOWN_IDB_NAMES in cleanup.ts so clearAppState() deletes the store between test runs. (2) __notestrTestForgottenSlots?: () => Promise<string[]> added to the Window interface in notestr-test-hooks.d.ts. (3) Hook implemented in client.tsx inside the existing isTestRuntime() useEffect block using a dynamic import of forgotten-slots.ts to avoid loading it in non-E2E builds; cleanup return also deletes the hook property.

architect_decisions.topic: Dynamic import vs static import for forgotten-slots in client.tsx
architect_decisions.decision: Used dynamic import (`await import('./forgotten-slots')`) inside the hook body so the forgotten-slots module is not bundled into the main chunk for non-E2E builds. Static import would have been simpler but adds the module unconditionally.
Added `delete window.__notestrTestForgottenSlots` to the useEffect return alongside the other hook deletions. This matches the existing cleanup pattern for all other hooks in the block.

tests.rationale: S5 introduces no logic of its own. Coverage is delegated to S6 (clearAppState exercising KNOWN_IDB_NAMES) and S7 (page.evaluate calling __notestrTestForgottenSlots).
